2026-05-01.headline: Apple Posts Record $111B March Quarter, Beats on All Metrics
2026-05-01.summary: Apple reported $111.2 billion in fiscal Q2 2026 revenue — a March quarter record, up 17% year over year — beating analyst estimates of $109.7 billion. iPhone revenue hit $56.99 billion, Services an all-time high of $30.98 billion, and EPS came in at $2.01 versus the $1.95 consensus. Apple's board authorized an additional $100 billion in share buybacks and raised its dividend to $0.27 per share.

2026-05-01.headline: Big Tech Q1 2026 Capex Tops $650B as Hyperscalers Beat Forecasts
2026-05-01.summary: Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft all beat Q1 2026 revenue estimates on the same evening, but Meta fell 7% after hours after raising its full-year capex guide to $125-$145 billion. Combined 2026 AI infrastructure spending across all five hyperscalers is now tracking toward $650 billion. Google Cloud grew 63% year over year to $20 billion, AWS grew 28%, and Microsoft's AI business hit $37 billion in annualized revenue, up 123% year over year.

2026-05-01.headline: Half of Google's $62.6B Profit Came From Anthropic Stake Markup
2026-05-01.summary: Nearly half of Alphabet's record $62.6 billion Q1 profit — about $28.7 billion — came from a required equity markup on its Anthropic stake, not from any operational business. When Alphabet invested more in Anthropic, the higher price it paid also forced a mark-to-market gain on its existing stake. Fortune and analysts noted that Google's cloud would have grown even faster if compute capacity were not constrained.

2026-05-01.headline: Musk-Altman OpenAI Trial Begins in Oakland Federal Court
2026-05-01.summary: Opening statements began in Elon Musk's federal trial against OpenAI, Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, and Microsoft in Oakland. Musk's attorney alleged that the defendants 'enriched themselves' and 'breached the very basic principles on which the charity was founded.' OpenAI's lead attorney called the lawsuit the work of a jealous competitor who 'will do anything he can to attack OpenAI.' The outcome could force OpenAI back to nonprofit status and award $130 billion in damages.

2026-05-01.headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Warns AI Bubble Poses Financial Stability Risk
2026-05-01.summary: The Federal Reserve held interest rates unchanged at its May meeting and issued an unusual warning about AI-related financial stability risks, citing the extreme concentration of AI investment among a small number of companies and the opacity of private valuations. Chair Powell pointed to Anthropic's $1 trillion secondary market valuation as an example of markets pricing assets with limited fundamental transparency.

2026-05-01.headline: Microsoft AI Business Hits $37B Annualized Revenue, Up 123%
2026-05-01.summary: Microsoft reported Q1 fiscal 2026 revenue of $82.89 billion, up 18% year over year, with its AI business hitting $37 billion in annualized revenue — a 123% increase. Azure guidance of 37-38% growth for Q3 came in as expected. The company's 15 million paid Copilot seats and tenfold growth in daily active users signal that enterprise AI monetization is accelerating beyond early skeptics' expectations.
2026-05-01.source: The Next Web / Big Tech Earnings

2026-04-30.headline: Alphabet Q1 2026: Cloud Up 63%, Profit Jumps 81% on Anthropic Gain
2026-04-30.summary: Alphabet reported Q1 2026 revenue of $109.9 billion, beating estimates by nearly $3 billion, with Google Cloud growing 63% year over year to $20 billion. Net profit jumped 81% to $62.6 billion, aided by a $37 billion equity securities gain largely from the Anthropic stake markup. Sundar Pichai said Google Cloud 'would have been higher if we were able to meet the demand,' raising the company's full-year capex guide to $180-$190 billion.

2026-04-30.headline: Meta Q1 Revenue Up 33% but Stock Falls on $145B Capex Hike
2026-04-30.summary: Meta posted $56.3 billion in Q1 revenue, up 33% — its fastest growth since 2021 — with earnings of $10.44 per share. But shares fell 7% after hours after the company raised its full-year 2026 capex guide to $125-$145 billion, citing higher component costs and expanded data center capacity. Meta's user count missed estimates, partly attributed to internet disruptions in Iran.

2026-04-30.headline: Amazon AWS Growth Accelerates to 28%, Bedrock Tokens Surge
2026-04-30.summary: Amazon reported Q1 net sales of $181.5 billion, up 17%, with AWS growing 28% year over year. Bedrock processed more tokens in Q1 2026 than in all prior years combined, with customer spend growing 170% quarter over quarter. Amazon's Trainium chip business is running at a $50 billion annualized revenue rate if valued as a standalone business.

2026-04-30.headline: LlamaCon: Meta Launches Llama API and Open-Source Defender Tools
2026-04-30.summary: Meta hosted its inaugural LlamaCon developer conference, announcing the Llama API in limited free preview — offering one-click API key creation, fine-tuning tools, and OpenAI SDK compatibility — alongside Llama Protection Tools and the Llama Defenders Program. Llama has now surpassed 1 billion downloads. Zuckerberg framed the event as a direct challenge to closed AI providers, saying open-source AI is the path to preventing any single company from controlling superintelligence.

2026-04-30.headline: China Blocks Meta's $2B Acquisition of Agentic AI Startup Manus
2026-04-30.summary: China's regulators blocked Meta's $2 billion acquisition of Manus, the Singapore-based agentic AI startup, on national security grounds and ordered a full unwind of the deal. The block cuts off Meta's attempt to acquire the autonomous agent technology at the center of Manus's platform, which originally emerged from a Chinese AI lab. The ruling complicates Meta's 'Personal Superintelligence' product vision, which relied on Manus's agent capabilities.

2026-04-30.headline: OpenAI Warns Mac Users to Update Apps After Supply Chain Attack
2026-04-30.summary: OpenAI issued an urgent alert requiring all macOS users to update ChatGPT, Codex, and Atlas desktop apps before May 8, after a compromised third-party JavaScript library pushed a remote access trojan via social engineering. OpenAI found no evidence of user data exposure and rotated its code-signing certificates as a precaution, but unupdated apps will stop working after the deadline.

2026-04-29.headline: Musk vs. Altman Trial Opens With Dueling Claims Over OpenAI Mission
2026-04-29.summary: The federal trial over Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI opened in Oakland, with Musk's attorney alleging that Altman, Brockman, and Microsoft 'enriched themselves' by converting OpenAI from a nonprofit and 'breached the very basic principles on which the charity was founded.' OpenAI's attorney characterized the suit as jealousy-driven, saying Musk 'will do anything he can to attack OpenAI' because he competes with it through xAI. The outcome could revert OpenAI to nonprofit status and block its IPO.

2026-04-29.headline: Four Hyperscalers Report Simultaneously: $650B Capex Era Begins
2026-04-29.summary: Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft reported Q1 2026 earnings simultaneously after the bell, with all four beating revenue estimates. The aggregate 2026 AI capex commitment across these four companies plus Apple is now on track to exceed $650 billion — more than the GDP of most European countries. Google Cloud grew 63%, AWS 28%, and Microsoft's AI revenue rose 123% year over year.

2026-04-29.headline: Google Signs Classified AI Deal With Pentagon
2026-04-29.summary: Google signed a classified AI contract with the Pentagon, making it the second major AI company — after OpenAI — to provide services for US Department of Defense classified networks. The deal prompted an open letter signed by over 560 Google employees urging the CEO to refuse military AI work, saying they want AI to 'benefit humanity, not be used in inhumane or extremely harmful ways.'

2026-04-29.headline: OpenAI Revenue Miss Report Triggers AI Stock Selloff
2026-04-29.summary: A Wall Street Journal report that OpenAI missed internal revenue and user growth targets triggered a broad selloff in AI-linked stocks, with Oracle and CoreWeave — both closely tied to OpenAI's infrastructure — falling sharply. OpenAI denied the report, but the S&P 500 fell 0.49% and the Nasdaq dropped 0.90% as investors questioned whether AI infrastructure spending was running ahead of revenue generation.

2026-04-29.headline: DeepSeek V4 Pro Launches on Ollama Cloud
2026-04-29.summary: DeepSeek released V4 Pro on Ollama's cloud platform, making its most capable model available for immediate deployment via the Ollama CLI. The launch positions DeepSeek V4 Pro as a direct cloud-accessible competitor to GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 at significantly lower per-token cost, continuing China's push to maintain competitive open-model capability against US frontier labs.

2026-04-29.headline: MIT Introduces Recursive Language Models to Solve Context Rot
2026-04-29.summary: MIT researchers introduced Recursive Language Models to address 'context rot' — reasoning degradation that frontier models experience when processing massive context windows. By recursively compressing and reprocessing context rather than treating it as a flat sequence, RLMs maintain reasoning fidelity over long-horizon tasks where standard transformers gradually lose coherence.

2026-04-28.headline: Musk-OpenAI Trial Starts Today Over $130B Nonprofit Breach Claim
2026-04-28.summary: The federal trial of Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI, Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, and Microsoft began with jury selection in Oakland. Musk alleges the defendants violated OpenAI's founding charitable mission by converting it to a for-profit and personally enriched themselves in the process, seeking damages of approximately $130 billion. The case could force OpenAI back to nonprofit status and derail its anticipated IPO.

2026-04-28.headline: Google Signs Classified Pentagon AI Deal, 560 Employees Protest
2026-04-28.summary: Google signed a classified AI contract with the Pentagon, drawing an immediate open letter from 560 employees urging CEO Sundar Pichai to refuse military AI work, citing concerns about AI being used for 'inhumane or extremely harmful' purposes. The deal comes as Google also faces internal debate about the ethics of its $40 billion Anthropic investment and the broader militarization of frontier AI.

2026-04-28.headline: China Blocks Meta's $2B Manus Acquisition on Security Grounds
2026-04-28.summary: Chinese regulators blocked Meta's $2 billion acquisition of Manus, the agentic AI platform that originally emerged from a Chinese startup, citing national security and ordering a full unwind. The ruling is a significant setback for Meta's autonomous agent strategy and marks one of the first times China has blocked a major outbound AI acquisition on national security grounds.

2026-04-28.headline: WSJ: OpenAI Missed Revenue and User Targets, Company Denies
2026-04-28.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that OpenAI fell short of internal revenue and user growth targets, triggering a selloff in AI-linked stocks including Oracle and CoreWeave. OpenAI denied the report. The news landed the day before the four largest hyperscalers reported earnings simultaneously, making AI monetization the dominant topic across all calls.

2026-04-28.headline: Perplexity Launches Sonar 2, Its In-House Search-Optimized LLM
2026-04-28.summary: Perplexity launched Sonar 2, its latest in-house language model optimized for fast, web-grounded search and answering, now available on Perplexity web. Sonar models are built specifically for search-first retrieval tasks rather than general reasoning, and Sonar 2 represents Perplexity's most capable attempt to reduce its dependence on third-party model APIs for its core product.

2026-04-28.headline: MIT Introduces Recursive Language Models to Fix Context Rot
2026-04-28.summary: MIT researchers introduced Recursive Language Models, a new architecture designed to solve 'context rot' — the reasoning degradation frontier models exhibit over very long context windows. RLMs recursively compress and reprocess context rather than treating it as a flat sequence, maintaining reasoning coherence on long-horizon tasks where standard transformers gradually lose track of earlier information.

2026-04-27.headline: Google Commits $40B to Anthropic in Cash and Compute
2026-04-27.summary: Google plans to invest up to $40 billion in Anthropic — $10 billion immediately at a $350 billion valuation, with up to $30 billion more tied to performance milestones — plus 5 gigawatts of dedicated TPU compute over five years. The deal, the largest single financial commitment to an AI startup outside Microsoft's OpenAI partnership, came days after Amazon expanded its own commitment to $25 billion. Anthropic now holds roughly $65 billion in fresh hyperscaler pledges and 10 gigawatts of reserved compute.

2026-04-27.headline: OpenAI and Microsoft Amend Deal, Ending Azure Exclusivity
2026-04-27.summary: OpenAI and Microsoft amended their foundational partnership to let OpenAI serve all its products through any cloud provider, ending Microsoft's exclusive hosting arrangement. Microsoft will no longer pay a revenue share to OpenAI, while OpenAI's payments to Microsoft continue through 2030. The change is expected to accelerate OpenAI's use of Google Cloud, where it already runs ChatGPT infrastructure.

2026-04-27.headline: Anthropic Hits $1 Trillion Valuation on Secondary Markets
2026-04-27.summary: Anthropic crossed a $1 trillion valuation on secondary markets, passing OpenAI in informal trading driven by investor FOMO, scarce share supply, and Claude momentum. Employees offered shares in a company tender at $350 billion chose to hold far more than expected, signaling high internal confidence in a higher IPO valuation. The company is reportedly targeting an October 2026 public listing.

2026-04-27.headline: Judge Rules No Attorney-Client Privilege With Claude in Court
2026-04-27.summary: Manhattan federal judge Jed Rakoff ordered a securities fraud defendant to hand over 31 documents prepared using Claude, ruling that no attorney-client relationship 'exists, or could exist, between an AI user and a platform such as Claude.' The ruling prompted urgent advisories from law firms telling clients to treat AI conversations with the same legal caution as emails.

2026-04-27.headline: Tencent Open-Sources Hy3, Its 295B-Parameter Flagship Model
2026-04-27.summary: Tencent released Hy3-preview, a 295-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 21 billion active parameters, a 256,000-token context window, and three reasoning modes. The model was led by ex-OpenAI researcher Yao Shunyu and built in under three months following infrastructure upgrades. It is available for free on OpenRouter and positions Tencent as a serious open-source competitor to Meta's Llama family.

2026-04-27.headline: Elizabeth Warren: AI Bubble Is 17x Bigger Than Dot-Com
2026-04-27.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren told a Vanderbilt audience that the current AI investment bubble is seventeen times larger than the dot-com bubble by comparable metrics, warning that concentration of AI infrastructure among a handful of companies poses systemic financial risk. Her remarks came the same week that Anthropic and OpenAI together received over $65 billion in new investment commitments from hyperscalers.
